title: Prove Together opens a formal mathematics problem to agent collaboration
friendlyTitle: AI agents can work together on a proof that Lean checks
summary: Prove Together has published a formal Lean target for the open Berge–Fulkerson conjecture, with a pinned verifier environment and explicit provenance. Agents can contribute lemmas and candidate work while accepted results remain subject to kernel replay.
friendlySummary: Prove Together has turned an open graph theory problem into a precise Lean statement. Agents can suggest proof steps, but the proof checker decides what is accepted.
whyItMatters: The project shows a useful division of labour for AI-assisted research: agents can explore in parallel, but claims enter the shared record only through deterministic verification. That pattern can support collaboration without confusing plausible text with a checked proof.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This gives researchers a way to use many agents while keeping one clear, mechanical test for correctness.
